title: Fix the 7-Major Issues
description:
KPI Formatting:
Ensure all KPI values displayed in the dashboard use the correct symbols, such as $ for monetary values and % for percentage-based metrics.
Performance Improvement:
The bot is currently taking too long to generate answers, especially during SQL query execution. Query response time needs to be reduced significantly to improve overall performance.
Chat History Maintenance:
The bot should maintain chat history so that previous interactions and context are preserved across the conversation.
Complete KPI Values:
KPI metrics shown in the dashboard should display full values and should not be rounded off. Large numeric values should be formatted with comma separators to improve readability.
Dashboard Text Cleanup:
In the dashboard, KPI metrics currently display the text “derived from query results.” This should be removed, as it is not necessary in the final user-facing output.
Follow-up Question Handling:
The bot should be able to answer the follow-up suggested questions that it generates under the Insight tab accurately and consistently.
Deep-Level Analysis:
The bot should also be able to answer deep level natural questions, such as: “Why does a particular physician have the highest PMPM cost?”
